objective: Compare conceptually different breakout detectors and identify repeatable market states where a detector may be conditionally useful even when its full-history return is weak.

candidates.concept: A price breakout accompanied by exceptional participation is more likely to persist.
candidates.fixed_rules: Select the strongest sector closing above its prior 55-session high, above its 200-session mean, with volume at least twice its prior 20-session average.

candidates.concept: Price acceleration is meaningful when unusually large relative to the asset's own recent volatility.
candidates.fixed_rules: Select the strongest sector whose five-session return exceeds two times its 20-session daily volatility scaled to five sessions, closes above its prior 20-session high, and remains above its 200-session mean.

candidates.concept: A large gap that holds through the session with volume confirmation may continue.
candidates.fixed_rules: Select the strongest sector gapping at least two percent, closing in the upper 30 percent of its daily range, trading at least 1.5 times average 20-session volume, and above its 200-session mean.

candidates.concept: An idiosyncratic sector move may contain more information than a market-wide move.
candidates.fixed_rules: Select the strongest positively trending sector whose one-session return exceeds the sector-universe median by at least two percentage points.

candidates.concept: Simultaneous breakouts across multiple sectors confirm broad risk appetite.
candidates.fixed_rules: When at least four sectors close above their prior 20-session highs, hold the strongest breakout; otherwise hold SHY.

candidates.concept: Sector breakouts are more reliable when confirmed by the broad market or broad sector participation.
candidates.fixed_rules: Select the strongest positively trending sector above its prior 55-session high only when SPY is above its prior 20-session high or 50-session sector breadth is at least 65 percent.

evaluation.conditional_gate: at least 20 state opportunities, five detections, ten-percent recall, sixty-percent profitable captures, fifty-percent capturing at least thirty percent of MFE, and detections in at least three calendar years
